decoys.alias: The diamond magnate who named a country after himself

source: Letter to his ambassador in London, 1876 (Pakenham, The Scramble for Africa)
note: The slice cost an estimated ten million Congolese lives.

quote: To think of these stars that you see overhead at night, these vast worlds which we can never reach. I would annex the planets if I could; I often think of that.

answer.name: Cecil Rhodes
answer.alias: The diamond magnate who named a country after himself

source: Quoted in W.T. Stead, The Last Will and Testament of Cecil John Rhodes (1902)
note: He had to settle for most of southern Africa.

quote: I believe I am the only statesman in the world who does not have a bank account. I hold no stock, I have no shares in any companies. I do not draw any dividends.
source: Speech to Krupp factory workers, Essen, 27 March 1936
note: He was a multimillionaire from Mein Kampf royalties and never paid tax on them.

quote: A hedgehog never attacks another animal except when it is attacked. No one should come near us.
source: Speech in Weimar, 6 November 1938 (quoted in The Times, 26 Sept 1939)
note: Ten months later the hedgehog invaded Poland.

quote: I am travelling to Auschwitz. Kisses, your Heini.
source: Letter to his wife Marga, July 1942 (published by Die Welt, 2014)
note: One of the only mentions of the Holocaust in 700 letters home.

quote: I am a man who is basically opposed to atrocities or ungentlemanly actions. In 1934, I promulgated a law against vivisection.
source: Interview with psychiatrist Leon Goldensohn, Nuremberg, 24 May 1946
note: His defence at the Nuremberg war crimes trial, more or less.

quote: Keep your good heart. Become a person who lets himself be guided primarily by warmth and humanity.

answer.name: Rudolf Höss
answer.alias: The commandant of Auschwitz

source: Farewell letter to his children, 11 April 1947
note: Written five days before he was hanged beside the Auschwitz crematorium.

quote: This is the epitaph I want on my tomb: Here lies one of the most intelligent animals who ever appeared on the face of the Earth.
source: Remark to his son-in-law Galeazzo Ciano, 19 December 1937 (Ciano's diary)
note: He was instead hung upside down from a petrol station in Milan.

quote: You cannot get rid of me because I am and always will be a socialist. You hate me because you still love me.
source: On being expelled from the Italian Socialist Party, 1914 (Mack Smith, Mussolini)
note: They did not, in fact, still love him.

quote: The rose’s bud had blossomed out, / Reaching out to touch the violet; / The lily was waking up / And bending its head in the breeze.
source: Poem 'Morning' (1895), trans. in PN Review 41 (1985)
note: Published when he was 17. It later appeared in Georgian school primers.

quote: I am comparatively happy when these people on the right come into power.
source: Meeting with Richard Nixon, Beijing, 21 February 1972
note: He opened with 'I like rightists.' Nixon took it well.

quote: I am only a lone monk walking the world with a leaky umbrella.
source: Conversation with Edgar Snow, December 1970 (Life magazine, April 1971)
note: In Chinese, 'a monk under an umbrella' is a pun meaning 'no law, no heaven'. Snow missed it.

quote: But I can’t listen to music too often; it gets on my nerves, rouses the desire to say charming nonsense, and stroke the heads of the people who, in spite of living in a dirty hell, are able to create such beauty.
source: On Beethoven's Appassionata, recorded by Maxim Gorky, 'Lenin the Man' (1924)
note: He continued: 'One must hit them on the heads, hit mercilessly.'

quote: Life is beautiful. Let the future generations cleanse it of all evil, oppression and violence, and enjoy it to the full.
source: Trotsky's Testament, 27 February 1940
note: Founder of the Red Army. Six months later Stalin's agent arrived with the ice axe.

quote: Above all, try always to be able to feel deeply any injustice committed against any person in any part of the world. It is the most beautiful quality of a revolutionary.
source: Farewell letter to his children, 1965
note: He personally oversaw executions at La Cabaña prison in 1959.

quote: If you like, give me a ten dollar bill green american in the letter because never I have not seen a ten dollars bill green american.
source: Letter to President Franklin D. Roosevelt, 6 November 1940 (US National Archives)
note: He claimed to be twelve. He was fourteen. He did not get the ten dollars.

quote: Am I a savage person? My conscience is clear.
source: Interview with Nate Thayer, Far Eastern Economic Review, October 1997
note: Roughly two million dead Cambodians were unavailable for comment.

quote: I’m an Internet expert too.
source: Remark to South Korean President Roh Moo-hyun, inter-Korean summit, October 2007
note: North Korea had, at the time, essentially no internet.

quote: It’s all a lie. They’re just pretending to praise me.
source: Remark to film director Shin Sang-ok, 7 March 1983 (Martin, Under the Loving Care...)
note: Said to a South Korean director he had kidnapped to make movies for him.

quote: Woman is female and man is male. According to a gynecologist, woman menstruates or suffers feebleness every month, while man, being a male, does not menstruate and he is not subject to the monthly period which is a bleeding.
source: The Green Book, Part III (1979)
note: Required reading in Libyan schools for three decades.

quote: Speaking about climate change is not a matter of intellectual luxury - the phenomenon is an actual fact.
source: Audio message aired by Al Jazeera, 29 January 2010
note: He blamed the US and recommended boycotting the dollar.

quote: Sometimes people mistake the way I talk for what I am thinking.
source: Barbet Schroeder's documentary General Idi Amin Dada: A Self Portrait (1974)
note: He also noted he never got a nursery school certificate.

quote: If you want to steal, steal a little in a nice way. But if you steal too much to become rich overnight, you’ll be caught.

answer.name: Mobutu Sese Seko
answer.alias: The Zairean dictator in the leopard-skin hat

source: Speech to party officials, 1976 (quoted in D.J. Gould, 'Patrons and Clients')
note: He personally stole an estimated five billion dollars, slowly.

quote: I have a sour face. Maybe that’s why they say I’m a dictator.
source: Speech, 24 April 1986 (La Nación, 'Las frases para el bronce de Pinochet')
note: The 3,000 dead and disappeared may have also contributed.

quote: My library is filled with UN condemnations.
source: Speech, 26 December 1986 (La Nación, 'Las frases para el bronce de Pinochet')
note: He did not read them.

quote: The war situation has developed not necessarily to Japan’s advantage.
source: Surrender broadcast (Gyokuon-hoso), 15 August 1945
note: Hiroshima and Nagasaki had been bombed the previous week.

quote: I have never been a material girl. My father always told me never to love anything that cannot love you back.

answer.name: Imelda Marcos
answer.alias: The first lady with 3,000 pairs of shoes

source: Interview in TIME magazine, November 1996
note: The Marcoses are estimated to have looted up to ten billion dollars.

quote: Imagine a society that subjects people to conditions that make them terribly unhappy, then gives them the drugs to take away their unhappiness. Science fiction? It is already happening to some extent in our own society.

answer.name: Ted Kaczynski
answer.alias: The Unabomber

source: Industrial Society and Its Future (1995), paragraph 145
note: Published by the Washington Post under threat of further bombings.

quote: I didn’t know what made things tick. I didn’t know what made people want to be friends. I didn’t know what made people attractive to one another. I didn’t know what underlay social interactions.
source: On his high-school years, in Michaud & Aynesworth, The Only Living Witness (1983)
note: He later worked a suicide crisis hotline.

quote: Pain’s not bad. It’s good. It teaches you things. Like when you put your hand in fire: Ow! You know not to do that again.
source: First prison interview, 60 Minutes Australia, 1981
note: A life lesson from a man serving nine life sentences.

quote: There’s nothing wrong with being incompetent. It just means you don’t have to do as much.
source: NBC interview, 1987
note: He never personally killed any of the Tate-LaBianca victims. He delegated.

quote: I don’t believe in hitting children.

answer.name: John Wayne Gacy
answer.alias: The killer clown

source: CBS 2 Chicago interview, 1992
note: He murdered 33 young men and boys and buried most of them under his house.

quote: Big deal. Death always went with the territory. See you in Disneyland.

answer.name: Richard Ramirez
answer.alias: The Night Stalker

source: To reporters after receiving 19 death sentences, 7 November 1989 (The Guardian)
note: He died of cancer on death row 24 years later, still waiting.

quote: I’m sailing with the rock, and I’ll be back, like Independence Day, with Jesus. June 6, like the movie. Big mother ship and all, I’ll be back, I’ll be back.

answer.name: Aileen Wuornos
answer.alias: The serial killer Charlize Theron played in Monster

source: Last words before execution, Florida, 9 October 2002 (Associated Press)
note: She declined a last meal and had a cup of coffee.

quote: I just sought a way to be someone I wasn’t. To be loved.

answer.name: Mark David Chapman
answer.alias: The guy who shot John Lennon

source: Parole hearing, Attica, October 2000 (BBC)
note: He has been denied parole thirteen times.

quote: With every man’s hand against me, I am here in despair. And why; For doing what Brutus was honored for…
source: Diary entry, April 1865
note: Written in a Virginia swamp with a broken leg, days before he was shot in a barn.

quote: I wonder what I will see when I get to the Lordy, I expect to see most splendid things, Beyond all earthly conception, When I am with the Lordy!

answer.name: Charles Guiteau
answer.alias: The guy who shot President Garfield

source: Poem 'I Am Going to the Lordy', recited on the gallows, 30 June 1882
note: He wrote it that morning, sobbed through the recital, and was hanged.

quote: The road gets dimmer and dimmer sometimes you can hardly see. But it’s fight man to man and do all you can, for they know they can never be free.

answer.name: Bonnie Parker
answer.alias: Bonnie, of Bonnie and Clyde

source: Poem 'The Trail's End' (1934)
note: Written weeks before police fired about 130 rounds into their Ford V-8.

quote: No, a merry life and a short one shall be my motto.

answer.name: Bartholomew Roberts
answer.alias: The most successful pirate of the Golden Age

source: Charles Johnson, A General History of the Pyrates (1724)
note: He captured over 400 ships and was killed by grapeshot at 39. Motto achieved.

quote: Do I do business with Canadian racketeers? I don’t even know what street Canada is on.
source: To reporters, c. 1931 (Schneider, Iced: The Story of Organized Crime in Canada)
note: Most of his whisky came from Canada.

quote: Del, don’t worry, we only kill each other.

answer.name: Bugsy Siegel
answer.alias: The mobster who built Las Vegas

source: To contractor Del Webb while building the Flamingo, 1946 (Jennings, 1967)
note: He was shot through the eye in his girlfriend's living room the next year.

quote: My life was wasted and spent foolishly, brought shame + suffering on my parents and siblings and will end soon.

answer.name: Whitey Bulger
answer.alias: The Boston mob boss who was secretly an FBI informant

source: Letter to three high-school students, 24 February 2015 (WBUR)
note: His career advice in the same letter: 'If you want to make crime pay, go to law school.'

quote: Had I robbed, plundered, ravished and murdered everything I met my character could not be painted blacker than it as present, thank God my conscience is as clear as the snow in Peru.

answer.name: Ned Kelly
answer.alias: The Australian outlaw with the homemade iron armour

source: The Cameron Letter, 14 December 1878
note: He had shot three policemen dead two months earlier.

quote: I don’t blame you for writing of me as you have. You had to believe other stories, but then I don’t know if any one would believe anything good of me anyway.
source: Interview with the Las Vegas (New Mexico) Gazette, December 1880
note: Said in handcuffs, aged 21, seven months before Pat Garrett shot him.

quote: We are guinea pigs in the sense that we are here to show how man, the caterpillar, can become a butterfly in the next kingdom.

answer.name: Marshall Applewhite
answer.alias: The Heaven's Gate cult leader

source: Speech at a recruitment meeting, Los Angeles, 9 April 1975 (Balch, 1998)
note: In 1997 he and 38 followers died in matching Nikes, waiting for a spaceship.
